hypothesis: Higher announced year-over-year GAAP diluted EPS change adds positive H20 market-relative forecast information beyond price momentum and market-relative strength, including the observed release response.
mechanism: Per-share earnings news can reveal current profitability and dilution, partly missed by prices. Same-release prior-year comparator is available at that release. It is neither consensus surprise nor a forecast revision.
event_universe: Frozen B2 analyzed targets only; US original 8-K Item 2.02 and attached original earnings statement from archived SEC source; no source substitutions after seeing results. KR assessed separately. No backup hypothesis authorized in this contract.
eps: (reported diluted GAAP EPS current quarter - same exhibit same prior-year quarter EPS) / (abs(current) + abs(prior)); both zero excluded. Only full-company as reported, quarter durations and fiscal cutoffs comparable, no adjusted/core, guidance, annual proxy or ambiguous table. No later revision or prior comparative from a later filing.
clock: Original SEC submission acceptance timestamp verified against archived submissions. This is verified filing availability, and earliest release across other IR channels or intraday receipt is unproven. Require same NY calendar date as 8-K reportDate and original. From first full exchange session strictly after acceptance local date, observe through its close then use next session open; correction known before this cutoff with matching report date excluded.
price: Reuse verified H1 R0 CORE adjusted price/mask and R0 S&P500 quote and quality mask. Full price coverage, no filling/symbol shifts, strictly next open after decision, H20 ends at entry+20 market sessions. Target is stock adjusted open-to-open minus S&P500 price-index counterpart. Price-only observations, no portfolio or costs.
signals: Price momentum MOM20 (diagnostic MOM63), market-relative RS63 (stock minus S&P500 63-session close return), 5-session reversal, VOL20, release-window stock minus index return from close strictly before SEC report date to decision close. Compare MOM20, MOM63, RS63 and EPS standalone, price-only model and otherwise identical additive price+EPS OLS. All fits standardized on fit only. No interaction to limit small-sample degrees of freedom.
split: Evaluation signal in 2024, H20 mature within 2024; fit through 2023 with exit strictly before 2024. Only H1 panel-covered and warmed sessions. Keep earlier same-issuer eligible event if H20 holding intervals overlap. Historical research already exposed. Recovered release dates are backfill.
gate: At least 30 eligible independent non-overlapping issuer changes, 12 issuers both splits individually, and at least 8 positive and 8 negative observations in each split, at least 5 occupied disjoint two-calendar-month evaluation clusters. Zero may remain as neutral. No future returns before gate. If only one market eligible proceed for that market.
primary: 2024 pooled event Spearman difference additive minus price-only, no same-day cross-sectional claim. Paired 5000-draw issuer x fixed two-calendar-month pigeonhole bootstrap, seed 132041. Diagnostic percentile 95% interval. Concentration: top fifth within evaluation, upper group paired excess H20 difference, and frozen standardized rank loss change by issuer; drop five largest absolute issuer contributions in arithmetic only. Also report half-year delta and EPS/price Spearman.
decision: Positive CI lower bound, positive half-year results, positive upper fifth lift and positive rank loss gain after removing largest five contributions required for an exploratory candidate. Negative or flat delta and upper fifth lift means NO_INCREMENTAL_SIGNAL, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. No Task15 without separate economic/PIT and independent approval gates.
